completion.definition: A first-leg episode begins when maker simulation leaves unpaired inventory. Natural completion means the opposite maker leg fills before unpaired_age; forced completion contains SHADOW_TAKER_FILL_SIM reason=unpaired_age. Cycles containing non-shadow FILL receipts are excluded from both clean classes.

source_window.coverage_warning: Available receipts cover less than 24 hours; metrics are not a 24-hour acceptance result.

target_yes_13c_to_no_96c.checkpoint_limitation: QUOTE_EVAL is throttled to roughly 1 Hz. The 0.25s and 0.5s rows carry forward the first post-fill receipt; this NDJSON cannot support tick-perfect sub-second book reconstruction.
